left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  BMI >= 25 kg/m2
  -  Adults aged 50 - 80 years old
  -  Successful biochemical, [OR]  haematological, [OR]  and urinalysis assessment at screening
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Current smokers, [OR]  or ex-smokers ceasing < 6 months ago
  -  existing  [OR] or significant past medical history of vascular disease  [OR] or medical conditions likely to affect the study measures
  -  Fructose  [OR] or lactose intolerant  [OR] subjects or known allergies to intervention treatments
  -  Those unprepared to adhere to dietary instructions
  -  Parallel participation in another research project involving dietary intervention  [OR] and/or sampling of biological fluids/ [OR] material
  -  Those on therapeutic diets  [OR] or having experienced substantial weight loss within 2 months of screening

-  Those taking flavonoid, [OR]  nitrate  [OR] / nitrite containing  [OR] or fish oil containing supplements  [AND]  [OR] (and unwilling to cease intake during, and 1 month preceding the trial) or unwilling to maintain existing intake of other supplements

right.raw_text: -  Prescribed hypoglycaemic, [OR]  anti-hypertensive, [OR]  vasodilator  [OR] or hormone replacement therapy (HRT) medication
